messages:
ops-bot: Incident bulletin — Detected an ingress connection leak causing proxy connection pool exhaustion in hosted edge (us-west-2, eu-west-1). Symptoms: delayed streaming starts, spikes of 502s for short requests. Detected 2026-03-22 18:02 UTC. Impact: ~4% of overall requests, higher for streaming-heavy customers. Status: mitigation in progress — rolling proxy restarts + timeout patch. Action/status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-276543 (internal runbook: https://go/release/ingress-leak-runbook) :rotating_light:

shannon: Thanks for the heads up. Who's oncall and what's the ETA for containment?

kai: I'm oncall. Started rolling restarts at 18:07 UTC. Deployed proxy image proxy:v2.14.3-hotfix with socket cleanup patch. Early telemetry shows node queue depth dropping ~1200 -> ~700 within first 5m in us-west-2. Continuing roll across nodes now.

dmitri: Also updated LB idle_conn_timeout 300s -> 90s to accelerate cleanup of stuck connections. No customer config changes required.

deploy-bot: Deploy event: proxy:v2.14.3-hotfix -> us-west-2. Progress: 3/12 nodes updated. CI checks: green. Deploy logs: https://logs.internal/proxy/deploy/2765432100

maria: I'm drafting the customer-facing note for the status page and support. Will post after ops review. Tentative message below.

maria: ```Customer-facing status update (draft):
We're investigating intermittent increased latency and occasional 502s affecting a subset of hosted API requests. Our engineers have identified a connection leak in the edge proxies and are rolling a hotfix now. We expect service restoration within the hour for most customers. We will provide another update in 15 minutes or when we have new information. Status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/INC-276543
``` :memo:

shannon: That looks good — please include a note about no expected data loss and include CSE contact handling instructions.

maria: Added. Pushing to status page now — support notified.

kai: Monitoring: token-level retry rate down 12% since patch on updated nodes. Streaming startup latency median improved ~120ms in patched region. If we don't see continued improvement after full roll we will consider temporarily scaling dedicated pools for heavy streamers as a follow-up mitigation.

dmitri: Assigning postmortem owner: dmitri. Triage tags: ingress, proxy, connection-leak, streaming. We should capture heap/socket stats and LB metrics for root cause.

ops-bot: Next update scheduled in 15 minutes or on significant status change. Incident severity: P2. If you are oncall and need escalation, ping @shannon or @dmitri. :white_check_mark:
